title: Self-Attention for Quantum Entanglement Prediction
summary: Quantum entanglement is a powerful resource for quantum-enhanced technologies. However, its reliable quantification remains challenging due to the exponential scaling of the Hilbert space with system size, which renders full state tomography infeasible. Moreover, experimentally estimating entanglement typically requires a large number of measurement samples leading to a significant overhead.
